outcome: Cesarean delivery secondary to labor arrest
cohort: Singleton pregnancies with cephalic-presenting fetuses, gestational age of 34 weeks+0 days or above, and no contraindication to vaginal delivery attending at the antenatal clinics of 3 maternity units from January 2021 to January 2022.
finding: The head circumference/obstetrical conjugate ratio is a reliable antenatal predictor of labor arrest leading to cesarean delivery.
